2014_spells.bones-of-the-earth.descripti: You cause up to six pillars of stone to burst from places on the ground that you can see within range. Each pillar is a cylinder that has a diameter of 5 feet and a height of up to 30 feet.
2014_spells.bones-of-the-earth.effectSum: Change a target: each pillar is a cylinder that has a diameter of 5 feet and a height of up to 30 feet
2014_spells.bones-of-the-earth.fullDescr: Using 1 action, you cause up to six pillars of stone to burst from places on the ground that you can see within range. Each pillar is a cylinder that has a diameter of 5 feet and a height of up to 30 feet; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, you can create two additional pillars for each slot level above 6th. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
